findings.title: Write lock held during I/O blocks all readers and causes redundant work
findings.body: The write lock acquired at line 48 is held while performing I/O (readWebAssetsFromFile on line 60 and the disabled readWebAssetsFromCDN on line 56), so every concurrent reader is blocked until that I/O completes. Combined with the double-checked locking pattern (RLock at line 41, then Lock at line 48), multiple goroutines that race to populate the cache after startup will all redundantly execute the file read and overwrite each other's results. The data race itself is correctly fixed, but a more efficient pattern would use sync.Once (with a reset path for Dev mode) or release the lock around the I/O and re-acquire it only to publish the result, so only one goroutine performs the slow work and readers are never blocked by it.
